description: Defines the class SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore which implements persistent storage for network error logging and reporting endpoints using SQLite, including methods for loading, adding, updating, deleting policies and endpoints, and managing background task priorities.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore
classes.description: A class implementing persistent storage for network error logging and reporting endpoints, using SQLite, with methods for managing policies and endpoints.

methods.name: LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Loads network error logging policies asynchronously.

methods.name: AddNelPolicy
methods.description: Adds a new network error logging policy.

methods.name: UpdateNelPolicyAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a given policy.

methods.name: DeleteNelPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a specified network error logging policy.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Loads reporting clients and endpoint groups.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates access time for an endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: GetQueueLengthForTesting
methods.description: Returns the current queue length for testing purposes.
